title: Arkret Applet Protocol Object
description: Schema-registry object for applet protocol metadata snapshots. Event payloads for ak.applet.* MUST use the typed payload definitions in event-payload.schema.json; this object is not a loose transport envelope and is closed at the top level except for x_* extensions.

applet_id.description: Stable applet identifier. MUST be either a did_core_id or the registered typed-id form ak:applet:<uuidv7>. Arbitrary opaque strings are not valid wire identifiers; bridge-specific aliases belong in namespace / external_ref fields.

service_id.description: Stable did_core_id of the service that hosts the applet runtime; current resolution is supplied by its authenticated service definition.

manifest.description: Applet manifest snapshot at registration time (capability requirements, supported intents, etc.).
